cases.name: accepted-full-reading
cases.note: Every field set and valid: nothing reported.

cases.name: accepted-minimal-lab
cases.note: Only collected: absent optional keys, reportStatus included, are valid.

cases.name: accepted-null-optional-fields
cases.note: Null optional keys are valid; a sent limit is ignored (the normaliser replaces it).

cases.name: collected-missing-lab-absent
cases.note: The lab key is not sent.

cases.name: collected-missing-skips-anchor-and-future
cases.note: With no collected the anchor is not checked, even when it is wrong.

cases.name: collected-invalid-calendar-date
cases.note: 30 February is not a real date.

cases.name: collected-invalid-seconds
cases.note: Seconds are not part of collected.

cases.name: collected-invalid-blank
cases.note: A blank collected is invalid, not missing.

cases.name: collected-invalid-not-a-string
cases.note: A number is not a collection date.

cases.name: collected-invalid-skips-future
cases.note: An invalid collected is not checked for the future either.

cases.name: collected-tomorrow-accepted
cases.note: One day after today is allowed (time zones).

cases.name: collected-day-after-tomorrow-rejected
cases.note: Two days after today is in the future.

cases.name: collected-day-after-across-month-end
cases.note: Today + 2 across the month end is rejected.

cases.name: collected-long-ago-accepted
cases.note: No lower limit on the collection date.

cases.name: anchor-date-only-noon
cases.note: A date-only collected anchors at T12:00:00.

cases.name: anchor-date-only-midnight-rejected
cases.note: A date-only collected must anchor at noon.

cases.name: anchor-instant-rejected
cases.note: An atTime anchor is not a local anchor.

cases.name: anchor-with-extra-instant-rejected
cases.note: A local anchor that also sends atTime is rejected.

cases.name: anchor-null-extra-key-accepted
cases.note: A null atTime is not sent.

cases.name: anchor-offset-841-rejected
cases.note: One minute past the highest offset.

cases.name: anchor-offset-minus-721-rejected
cases.note: One minute below the lowest offset.

cases.name: unit-fold-removes-spaces
cases.note: The fold removes spaces: x10^9 /L is x10^9/L.

cases.name: unit-unlisted-case-variant-rejected
cases.note: The fold keeps case and NMOL/L is not listed.

cases.name: unit-other-unit-rejected
cases.note: No conversion: mg/dL is not accepted for a mmol/L Lab Test.

cases.name: unit-blank-rejected
cases.note: A blank unit is not the Lab Test's.

cases.name: value-comma-decimal-rejected
cases.note: A comma decimal is not the grammar.

cases.name: value-limit-accepted
cases.note: A comparator, one space and a number.

cases.name: value-limit-without-space-rejected
cases.note: Exactly one space after the comparator.

cases.name: value-limit-two-spaces-rejected
cases.note: Exactly one space after the comparator.

cases.name: value-unicode-comparator-rejected
cases.note: Only ASCII comparators: the entry sheet and Agents send <=.

cases.name: value-invalid-skips-bounds
cases.note: No bounds check without a number.

cases.name: out-of-bounds-skips-implausible
cases.note: Outside hardBounds: the hard reject only.

cases.name: no-plausible-bounds-never-warned
cases.note: A Lab Test without plausibleBounds never warns.

cases.name: limit-exclusive-at-hard-min-accepted
cases.note: < 0: the bound is checked as the value.

cases.name: text-blank-accepted
cases.note: Blank text is valid: the normaliser writes it as null.

cases.name: report-status-unknown-rejected
cases.note: Only final or interim may be written.

cases.name: fasting-false-rejected
cases.note: Only true or empty: false is not written.

cases.name: every-error-in-table-order
cases.note: Issues follow the Validation table's row order.

cases.name: errors-with-a-warning
cases.note: A soft warning is reported beside hard rejects.
